reference_sql:
SELECT promo_code, promo_type, discount_pct,
       CASE WHEN promo_type = 'clearance' THEN 'clearance'
            WHEN discount_pct >= 30 THEN 'deep'
            ELSE 'standard'
       END AS promo_class
FROM promotions
